description:
11 Wycherley Terrace, College Road, Cork T12 YK6P
Patricia Stokes Auctioneers & Valuers are delighted to present 11 Wycherley Terrace to the market. Originally dating back to 1890, this charming period home beautifully blends vintage character with surprising modern functionality.  Extending to approximately 57.78 sq. m (622 sq. ft), the property boasts gas central heating and an impressive D Energy Rating, a rare feature for a home of its era, reflecting the significant care and enhancements to this home over the years.
Tucked away in a tranquil and highly sought-after residential enclave off College Road, the property enjoys the enviable private position backing directly onto the grounds of the prestigious Hayfield Manor Hotel.
Location is paramount, and 11 Wycherley Terrace occupies one of Cork's most desirable, central, and vibrant postal addresses.  Situated literally on the doorstep of University College Cork (UCC) and within easy reach of MTU it makes it a prime location for academics, professionals, or investors.  The property is also perfectly positioned close to Cork's premier healthcare hubs, including Bons Secours Hospital, Mercy University Hospital, and the Cork University Hospital (CUH).  A short, scenic stroll along College Road takes you straight into the heart of Cork City Centre. The historic Fitzgerald's Park, The Mardyke Arena, and the picturesque banks of the River Lee are all nearby, offering fine dining, cultural experiences, and recreational amenities right at your disposal.
Accommodation
Ground Floor
Entrance hall:
With its fire engine front door with glazed inset this entrance acts as a set down and draft excluder for the rest of the house.  Finished with wood laminate flooring it is an ideal area for coats and shoes.
Living Room: 5.4m x 3.6m
Step through the entrance into a surprisingly expansive, bright, and airy open-plan lounge. Flooded with natural light from the front, this inviting space retains a cozy atmosphere while providing a generous layout for entertaining or quiet relaxation. Finished with carpet this room has a feature fireplace in black marble with wood surround sitting at its centre.  Fitted with electric fire.   A clever tuck away under the stairs is an ideal spot for working from home.  Fitted with recessed lights. 
Kitchen cum Dining Room: 3.4m x 3.0m
Positioned to the rear of the home the open plan kitchen cum dining room is extensive in size and accessed via double doors from the living room allowing both spaces to become one.  The kitchen offers a host of storage in its fitted units at both floor and eye level with extensive counter top workspace.  Finished in wood with appliances to include double built in oven at eye level, hob with integrated extractor fan, free standing fridge freezer, washing machine and tumble dryer.  Tiled over countertop space a single drainer sink sits beneath the window looks out into a small yard to the rear.  The yard is access via door from the back of the kitchen.  A tremendous roof light was added to this room in recent years to ensure is it flooded with natural light throughout the day.
First Floor
Stairs and landing

Finished with carpet the staircase arrives to a carpeted landing with gable window providing natural light to both levels.
Bedroom 1: 4.5m x 2.6m
The bedroom of this home is exceptionally spacious and peaceful retreat with ample space for soft furnishings and rest.  Finished with wood floor this room together with the bathroom and walk in robe could be reconfigured to give two bedrooms should the next purchaser wish. 
Walk-In Wardrobe:
Walk-in wardrobe offering great storage space and modern convenience.
Bathroom / En-Suite: (2.6m x 1.9m)
Conveniently located off the main bedroom the bathroom if fitted with three-piece white suite to include sink set within fitted vanity unit with mirror over, wc and extra-large walk-in shower with double doors.  Finished in punch out tones and neutrally tiled.   Gable window to give natural light and ventilation. 

Strictly by prior appointment with sole selling agent Patricia Stokes Auctioneers & Valuers.
